Content win[] (Leona x6, Poppy x1 at 2+ items) matches the packet levelChart exactly and both agree with the 51.59% Poppy-favored winrate over 3216 games only kicking in once Poppy's Anti-Dash W and R can punish Leona's committed E dash — no contradiction.
spikes[] correctly identify Leona's level-2 E-Q all-in spike, the level-6 R Solar Flare double-stun stack, and the 2+ item flip once Poppy's Anti-Dash W and R can punish her committed engage.
